item.title: Senate Takes Up Trump’s Sweeping Elections Measure
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. - The Senate began debate on an elections bill that is a top priority for the President. The SAVE America Act would require ID to vote and proof of citizenship to register to vote. The President is urging Republicans to add non-elections related provisions to the measure.

item.title: Gov. Whitmer declares state of emergency for Delta County following blizzard
item.description: The state of emergency authorizes the use of all available state resources to assist local response and recovery operations in the affected counties.

item.title: String of Terror-Related Attacks Raises National Security Concerns Amid DHS Shutdown
item.description: A string of terror-related attacks across the U.S. is raising new concerns about national security. Those concerns coming as the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) remains shut down and as a top counter-terrorism official in the Trump administration resigned abruptly Monday.

item.title: Paris Hilton backs Michigan bill to limit restraints in youth transport to treatment programs
item.description: Paris Hilton urged Michigan lawmakers to pass legislation restricting how minors are transported to residential treatment programs, sharing her own traumatic experience. Supporters say the bill would close a regulatory gap by banning restraints and overnight removals.

item.title: Hall promotes transparency reforms, tax cuts during Sunshine Week
item.description: Michigan House Speaker Matt Hall highlighted transparency reforms during a Sunshine Week press conference while promoting a broader policy agenda. He also pushed for tax cuts, energy changes, and action on military and health care legislation.

item.title: Negaunee Public Library receives Pizza Hut Foundation grant for literacy program expansions
item.description: A 'Slice of Literacy' Grant from the Pizza Hut Foundation has awarded the Negaunee Public Library with $6,000, paired with another $2,000 from the Friends of the Library. This will fund essential needs for its summer programs, while helping build new ones.

item.title: Marquette County officials continue to monitor March blizzard aftermath
item.description: Marquette County's Emergency Operations Center continues to closely monitor the blizzard that has quickly made snowfall history in the area. In its third day of action, the cooperation is addressing a number of aftermath concerns.
